surgery_rule.clearance_required_message: You indicated previous surgery without confirmed medical clearance to exercise. For your health and safety, plan generation has been paused. Please consult a qualified physician or healthcare specialist to receive exercise clearance before proceeding.

knee_pain.label: Knee pain or knee injury
knee_pain.warning: Knee precaution: Avoid high-impact jumping, heavy deep squats, or sharp knee torsion. Discontinue any movements that strain the knee joint.

lower_back_pain.label: Lower back pain
lower_back_pain.warning: Lower back precaution: Avoid heavy spinal loading, extreme back extensions, or uncontrolled rotational torque. Focus on neutral spine alignment.

neck_pain.label: Neck or cervical pain
neck_pain.warning: Neck / cervical precaution: Avoid poses or movements exerting direct pressure or hyperextension on the neck. Maintain neutral cervical posture.

shoulder_pain.label: Shoulder pain or injury
shoulder_pain.warning: Shoulder precaution: Avoid heavy overhead loads, behind-the-neck presses, or deep dips. Keep exercises strictly within a comfortable, pain-free range.

wrist_pain.label: Wrist pain or injury
wrist_pain.warning: Wrist precaution: Limit direct full-weight bearing on extended wrists. Consider forearm or neutral wrist grip modifications.

ankle_pain.label: Ankle pain or injury
ankle_pain.warning: Ankle precaution: Avoid plyometric jumping or abrupt lateral direction changes. Prioritize stable, low-impact movements.

arthritis.label: Arthritis
arthritis.warning: Arthritis precaution: Focus on gentle, low-impact range of motion. Never push through joint inflammation or sharp articular pain.

general_disclaimer: FitFlow AI does not provide medical diagnoses or individual clinical advice. Always consult a qualified medical professional before undertaking new physical activities.
